stories.title: Rondônia conquista 18 das 24 vagas em concurso nacional de café canéfora

en.title: Rondônia wins 18 of 24 spots in national canephora coffee competition
en.summary: Rondônia secured 18 of 24 spots in the national phase of The Best of Canephora Brazil Edition 2026, a competition showcasing the country's top robusta coffees. The national stage took place in September in Minas Gerais, with winners to be announced in November in Rondônia.

stories.title: Justiça converte em preventiva a prisão de suspeito de matar companheira com facada no pescoço enquanto dormia em Cosmópolis

en.title: Court converts to preventive detention the arrest of suspect in girlfriend's stabbing death in Cosmópolis
en.summary: A court upheld preventive detention for Patrick Silva do Nascimento, arrested for fatally stabbing his 25-year-old girlfriend while she slept in their home in São Paulo state. The killing occurred early Tuesday, and a knife was recovered by police.

stories.title: Flávio evita se posicionar sobre MP das bets, mas diz que Lula ‘agrediu’ clubes de futebol

en.title: Flávio avoids taking stance on betting measure but says Lula 'attacked' football clubs
en.summary: A political figure avoided positioning himself on a betting-related measure while criticizing the president's approach toward football clubs.

stories.title: Gato perde visão de um olho após ser encontrado ferido em rua de Campinas; polícia investiga

en.title: Cat loses sight in one eye after being found injured on street in Campinas; police investigate
en.summary: Police are investigating suspected animal cruelty after a cat named Tigrinho was found wounded on a street in São Paulo state, suffering injuries to the head, eyes, and palate that resulted in vision loss.

stories.title: Deputada mais votada do PT entra na campanha de Lula para reforçar presença nas redes

en.title: Most-voted PT deputy enters Lula's campaign to strengthen presence on social networks
en.summary: A highly voted PT deputy is joining President Lula's campaign efforts to increase engagement on social media platforms.

stories.title: Deputada estadual mais votada de SP apresentou projetos de lei que repetem textos de outros políticos e erra até a própria cidade

en.title: Most-voted state deputy in São Paulo presented bills copying text from other politicians and misspelled her own city
en.summary: São Paulo's most-voted state deputy, who received 1.96 million votes, submitted legislative proposals containing duplicated content from other legislators, according to analysis by BBC News Brasil.

stories.title: Estrangeiros colocam recorde de R$ 10 bilhões na Bolsa brasileira após 1º turno; entenda o movimento

en.title: Foreign investors place record R$ 10 billion on Brazilian stock exchange after first round
en.summary: Foreign investors deposited a record R$ 10.06 billion into Brazilian stocks in a single trading day following the first round of elections, with the stock exchange rising 7.7% on the same day.

stories.title: Justiça homologa plano de recuperação extrajudicial do Grupo Pão de Açúcar

en.title: Court approves Grupo Pão de Açúcar's extrajudicial recovery plan
en.summary: A court has approved an extrajudicial recovery plan for Grupo Pão de Açúcar.

stories.title: Justiça aprova plano de recuperação extrajudicial do Pão de Açúcar

en.title: Court approves Pão de Açúcar's out-of-court recovery plan
en.summary: A São Paulo court approved the Pão de Açúcar Group's out-of-court recovery plan on Wednesday. The plan, backed by creditors representing 57.49% of claims, involves renegotiating 4.5 billion reais in debt.

stories.title: Criança de 12 anos morre após brincadeira em escola no Paraná; polícia investiga omissão de socorro

en.title: 12-year-old child dies following play activity at school in Paraná; police investigate failure to provide aid
en.summary: A 12-year-old child died following a play activity at a school in Paraná state. Police are investigating whether proper emergency assistance was provided.

stories.title: Bancos estrangeiros veem mais ganhos no Brasil após 1º turno; o que pode sustentar o otimismo?

en.title: Foreign banks see greater gains in Brazil after first round; what could sustain optimism?
en.summary: JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, and UBS GWM identify opportunities for Ibovespa and real appreciation based on electoral developments, though they highlight associated risks.

stories.title: Como mídia chinesa viu vantagem de Flávio sobre Lula no 1º turno

en.title: How Chinese media saw Flávio's advantage over Lula in the first round
en.summary: Chinese media coverage examined the first round electoral results, focusing on Flávio's perceived advantages compared to Lula.

stories.title: Turquia envia apoio militar à Arábia Saudita para combate contra houthis

en.title: Turkey sends military support to Saudi Arabia to fight Houthis
en.summary: Turkey is providing defensive and technical assistance to Saudi Arabia in its conflict against Iranian-aligned Houthis from Yemen. The support follows Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia's commitment to their jointly-formed collective defense alliance.

stories.title: Novo declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno

en.title: Novo party declares support for Flávio Bolsonaro in second round
en.summary: The Novo party officially endorsed senator Flávio Bolsonaro for the presidential runoff election. The party's president stated the support aims to defeat the PT government led by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the second round scheduled for the 25th.

stories.title: Salto em custo de captação impacta mundo empresarial dos EUA

en.title: Surge in borrowing costs impacts U.S. business sector
en.summary: A wave of selling in U.S. Treasury securities is causing American companies to revise their funding plans and raising default risks for lower-rated firms. Higher debt issuance costs are reverberating through the business community.

stories.title: Influencer eleita pelo PT diz que ódio a lulismo não deixa sociedade 'ver quem é Flávio'

en.title: PT-backed influencer says hatred of Lulism prevents society from seeing who Flávio is
en.summary: Elected federal deputy Ana Elisa stated that the far-right dominates social media and that hostility toward the PT party prevents people from understanding Flávio Bolsonaro's identity. She was attending a meeting of the PT parliamentary base discussing the second round.

stories.title: Tarcísio minimiza fala de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre mudar Constituição e faz críticas ao Minha Casa, Minha Vida

en.title: Tarcísio downplays Flávio Bolsonaro's remarks about changing Constitution and criticizes Minha Casa, Minha Vida
en.summary: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas downplayed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's statements regarding constitutional changes, arguing that certain fiscal, judicial, and political reforms require constitutional amendments.
